title: Token Preference Optimization with Self-Calibrated Visual-Anchored Rewards for Hallucination Mitigation
authors_zh: Jihao Gu, Yingyao Wang, Meng Cao, Pi Bu, Jun Song, Yancheng He, Shilong Li, Bo Zheng
paper_type_zh: 视觉落地的 token 级偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 使用既有偏好对训练视觉语言模型、但没有可扩展 token 级幻觉标注的读者。
one_line: TPO dynamically rewards preference-pair tokens by how much their predictions depend on the original image rather than a corrupted image.
TPO 按 token 预测对原图而非扰动图的依赖程度，动态加权既有偏好对中的训练奖励。
why: It makes visual grounding a dynamic, per-token training reward instead of assigning the same preference signal to every response token.
inclusion_reason: It changes the reward weight consumed for every token in an existing multimodal preference pair according to dynamically measured visual grounding.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language preference optimization often assigns one reward to a whole chosen or rejected response. Hallucination, however, is usually localized: a few nouns, attributes, or relations may be unsupported by the image while surrounding text is harmless. Existing fine-grained approaches rely on expensive human segment labels, fixed hallucination rewards, or separate scoring models. They do not readily show which generated tokens are actually grounded in visual input at the current training step.

The paper asks how existing multimodal preference pairs can produce scalable token-level grounding rewards without new fine-grained annotations. It measures how each token's output logits change when the original image is replaced by a corrupted version. A large change marks a visually anchored token. The training objective then rewards or penalizes that token differently according to whether it occurs in the preferred or dispreferred response, updating the signal as the policy changes.

视觉语言偏好优化常为整个入选或拒绝回答分配一个奖励。然而，幻觉通常是局部的：少数名词、属性或关系可能没有图像支持，而周围文本没有问题。现有细粒度方法依赖昂贵的人类片段标签、固定的幻觉奖励或单独的评分模型。它们难以直接显示，在当前训练步骤中哪些生成 token 真正以视觉输入为依据。

论文要回答的是：既有多模态偏好对如何在不增加新的细粒度标注时产生可扩展的 token 级落地奖励。它测量当原图被扰动图替换时，每个 token 输出 logit 的变化。较大变化标记一个视觉锚定 token。训练目标随后根据该 token 出现在入选还是拒绝回答中，对它进行不同的奖励或惩罚，并随策略变化更新该信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TPO defines a token's visual relevance counterfactually. The same prompt and preceding response tokens are evaluated twice: once with the raw image and once with a noise-corrupted image. The difference in raw logits is the visual-anchor score. If corrupting the image changes a token's prediction substantially, the token is treated as dependent on visual evidence rather than merely on language priors.

The score is then self-calibrated into opposite reward behavior for the two sides of a preference pair. In a preferred response, visually anchored tokens receive larger reward; in a rejected response, the calibration reverses so visually anchored problematic tokens receive lower reward. Thus the method does not filter tokens once before optimization. It makes each token's contribution to the DPO-style objective dynamic and model dependent, tying the training signal to visual sensitivity.

TPO 以反事实方式定义一个 token 的视觉相关性。相同的提示和前序回答 token 被评估两次：一次使用原图，一次使用加入噪声的扰动图。原始 logit 的差异就是视觉锚定分数。如果扰动图像会显著改变一个 token 的预测，该 token 就被视为依赖视觉证据，而不是仅仅依赖语言先验。

该分数随后被自校准为偏好对两侧相反的奖励行为。在入选回答中，视觉锚定 token 获得更大奖励；在拒绝回答中，校准反转，使视觉锚定的问题 token 获得更低奖励。因此，该方法不是在优化前一次性过滤 token。它使每个 token 对类 DPO 目标的贡献具有动态性并依赖模型，将训练信号绑定到视觉敏感性。

title: Method
方法
html:
At every training step, TPO adds scheduled noise to the image embedding, creating a corrupted image. For each response token, it subtracts the corrupted-image raw logit from the original-image raw logit. The method applies a sigmoid and a margin of 0.5 to turn the difference into a calibrated reward. For chosen responses, the reward grows with visual sensitivity; for rejected responses, it grows as visual sensitivity decreases. If the score is zero, the calibrated factor is one and has no effect.

The factor multiplies each token probability inside a KL-constrained preference objective. Both policy and reference rewards are calculated, and the policy-side value is recomputed as training changes. The authors use RLHF-V's 5K preference pairs directly, without its fine-grained human annotations, on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2-VL backbones. They test reward assignment on one or both preference sides, noise-step schedules, and the margin parameter; the reported best image corruption is an intermediate 500 steps.

在每个训练步骤，TPO 向图像嵌入加入预定噪声，创建扰动图像。对于每个回答 token，它用原图条件下的原始 logit 减去扰动图条件下的原始 logit。该方法施加 sigmoid 和 0.5 的边际，将差异转化为校准奖励。对于入选回答，奖励随视觉敏感性增长；对于拒绝回答，奖励随视觉敏感性下降而增长。如果分数为零，校准因子为一，不产生影响。

该因子乘入一个受 KL 约束的偏好目标中的每个 token 概率。策略和参考模型的奖励都会被计算，并且策略侧数值随训练变化而重新计算。作者直接使用 RLHF-V 的 5K 偏好对，而不使用其细粒度人工标注，在 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2-VL 骨干上训练。他们测试在偏好对一侧或两侧分配奖励、噪声步调度和边际参数；报告中最佳图像扰动为中等程度的 500 步。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TPO raises AMBER F1 from 74.3 to 85.0, MMHal score from 2.01 to 2.47, and HallusionBench average accuracy from 47.21 to 50.22 while keeping general benchmarks close to or above the base model. On LLaVA-1.5-13B, it reaches 88.0 AMBER F1, 2.72 MMHal score, and 50.93 HallusionBench average accuracy. On Qwen2-VL-7B, TPO improves MMHal score from 3.5 to 4.2 and lowers the reported hallucination rate from 29.0 to 18.8, while ordinary DPO changes those metrics only slightly.

The ablations connect outcomes to the reward design. Rewarding only chosen or only rejected tokens improves several hallucination measures, but giving the opposite visual correlation can fall below the untrained backbone. The best performance occurs at 500 noise steps, not at the smallest or largest corruption. Analysis finds noun and adjective tokens have higher visual-anchor scores than other tokens, and image-attention weight on MMHal responses rises from 0.14 before training to 0.17 afterward. These results support the claim that the signal changes visual grounding rather than merely adding a generic preference loss.

在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，TPO 将 AMBER F1 从 74.3 提高到 85.0，将 MMHal 分数从 2.01 提高到 2.47，将 HallusionBench 平均准确率从 47.21 提高到 50.22，同时使通用基准接近或超过基础模型。在 LLaVA-1.5-13B 上，它达到 88.0 的 AMBER F1、2.72 的 MMHal 分数和 50.93 的 HallusionBench 平均准确率。在 Qwen2-VL-7B 上，TPO 将 MMHal 分数从 3.5 提升到 4.2，并将报告的幻觉率从 29.0 降至 18.8，而普通 DPO 对这些指标的改变很小。

消融实验将结果与奖励设计联系起来。只奖励入选或只奖励拒绝 token 都改善了若干幻觉测量，但采用相反的视觉相关性可能低于未训练骨干。最佳性能出现在 500 个噪声步骤，而非最小或最大扰动。分析发现，名词和形容词 token 的视觉锚定分数高于其他 token，MMHal 回答上的图像注意力权重从训练前的 0.14 上升到训练后的 0.17。这些结果支持该信号改变视觉落地，而不只是增加泛化偏好损失的主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is to make visual dependence, rather than response membership alone, determine a token's training reward. Previous preference pairs say which response is better but not which words within it must be grounded in the image. TPO produces that missing granularity from a controlled perturbation of the same input image, avoiding a manually annotated segment reward and avoiding a separate token scorer.

Its self-calibration is also distinctive. Positive and negative responses do not receive the same visual score with opposite labels; the calibration changes the direction of reward so that a visually dependent token has an appropriate role on each side of the pair. Because the policy-side score is recomputed throughout training, the record's effective reward surface evolves with the model. This is a dynamic training-use rule for fixed pairs, not a new hallucination dataset.

该贡献在于让视觉依赖，而不是只让回答所属的一侧，决定一个 token 的训练奖励。以往偏好对说明哪个回答更好，却不说明其中哪些词必须以图像为依据。TPO 从同一输入图像的受控扰动中产生这种缺失的粒度，避免使用人工标注的片段奖励，也避免使用单独的 token 评分器。

其自校准也具有独特性。正负回答并不是接收同一个视觉分数和相反标签；校准改变奖励方向，使视觉依赖 token 在样本对两侧拥有适当作用。由于策略侧分数在整个训练中被重新计算，记录的有效奖励表面随模型演化。这是针对固定样本对的动态训练使用规则，而不是一个新的幻觉数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The visual-anchor score depends on the image corruption process, and the reported results show that noise level materially affects performance. It may identify tokens sensitive to visual perturbation without fully distinguishing correct visual reasoning from all forms of correlation or language bias. The method adds an image corruption and additional scoring path at every training step. The authors propose extending the method to corruption of specific objects, but this broader capability is not established by the reported experiments.
视觉锚定分数依赖图像扰动过程，报告结果显示噪声水平会实质影响性能。它可能识别对视觉扰动敏感的 token，却不能完全区分正确视觉推理与所有形式的相关性或语言偏差。该方法在每个训练步骤增加一次图像扰动和额外评分路径。作者提出将该方法扩展到对特定对象的扰动，但报告实验尚未证明这一更广泛能力。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use TPO when a vision-language preference dataset already has chosen and rejected answers but lacks fine-grained grounding labels. It provides a reproducible way to turn image sensitivity into a token reward and to use the same pairs more selectively. Before adoption, verify image preprocessing and corruption consistency, evaluate whether high-score tokens correspond to the visual attributes that matter in the deployment task, compare against a response-level DPO control at equal compute, and audit the licensing of the image and preference sources.
当一个视觉语言偏好数据集已经有入选和拒绝答案、却缺少细粒度落地标签时，可以使用 TPO。它提供一种可复现方式，将图像敏感性转为 token 奖励，并更有选择性地使用同一批样本对。在采用之前，应核验图像预处理和扰动的一致性，评估高分 token 是否对应部署任务中重要的视觉属性，在相同计算量下与回答级 DPO 对照比较，并审计图像和偏好来源的许可。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Equations 3–5 before Equation 11: the essential record transformation is original-image versus corrupted-image scoring followed by side-specific calibration. Then read Table 3 and the noise-step analysis, which prevent the mistaken interpretation that any perturbation-based token reward is beneficial. For reproduction, log the corruption schedule, image encode/decode path, margin, reward updates for policy and reference models, pair source, and benchmark protocol; these details determine which tokens receive a changed optimization signal.
应在公式 11 之前阅读公式 3 至 5：本质的记录变换是原图与扰动图评分，然后进行样本对一侧专属校准。随后阅读表 3 和噪声步骤分析，它们防止将任何基于扰动的 token 奖励都误解为有益。复现时应记录扰动调度、图像编码、解码路径、边际、策略和参考模型的奖励更新、样本对来源和基准协议；这些细节决定哪些 token 获得改变后的优化信号。
